description: Architecture layer definitions for Capability Seam consistency checking. Each capability family declares its definition, providers, consumers, and allowed dependency edges. The allowlist entries each carry a removal date and owner.

kernel.description: Minimal immutable Trust Kernel — never a plugin, never depends on product packages

schema.description: Schema Registry — depends only on utilities

core.description: Product API spine — session, system-prompt, tools, agent, agent-loop

llm.description: LLM capability: Service Definition/Consumer + DeepSeek providers
llm.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

shell.description: Shell capability: Service Definition + local/pwsh providers + shell Consumers
shell.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

fs.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

session.description: Durable session data: persistence, projection, titles, telemetry
session.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

sdk.description: JSON-RPC protocol, server, and TypeScript client
sdk.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

sandbox.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

workflow.description: Workflow capability + worker-thread provider + tool Consumer
workflow.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

interaction.rule: consumer must not deep-import provider src/*

allowlist.reason: Legacy direct import pending migration to Service Definition

rules.no_consumer_deep_import: Consumers must import from the Service Definition package, not from a provider's src/*
rules.no_provider_depends_on_app: Providers must not depend on apps/* or UI packages
rules.no_agent_loop_hardcoded_provider: agent-loop must not hardcode a specific provider implementation
rules.require_service_definition: Every replaceable capability must have a Service Definition package
rules.require_provider_fixture: Every Service Definition must have at least one provider fixture
rules.require_consumer_test: Every capability must have a consumer composition test
rules.require_unload_test: Every capability must have an unload rollback test
